question: Should OpenClaw add a narrow per-target-agent subagent cap now, and if so should the public config shape be agents.list[].subagents.maxConcurrent rather than the issue's proposed top-level agents.list[].maxConcurrent?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the fix adds public config and scheduler semantics in an area where AGENTS.md and VISION.md require a high bar for new config surface.

options.title: Add scoped subagent cap
options.body: Add agents.list[].subagents.maxConcurrent, validate and document it, and enforce it for target-agent subagent runs while preserving the global cap.

options.title: Fold into lane design
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader sessions_spawn lane model is designed, avoiding a narrow setting that might be superseded.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Close this direction and keep only the global cap plus prompt/tool-policy workarounds, accepting that local-model target agents cannot be serialized independently.

recommendation.title: Add scoped subagent cap
recommendation.body: Add agents.list[].subagents.maxConcurrent, validate and document it, and enforce it for target-agent subagent runs while preserving the global cap.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the central concurrency resolver and already reviewed this issue's shape and remaining gap.
